name: Heleket – Crypto Gateway for WooCommerce
author: heleket

sections.description:
Important

The YooKassa plugin is compatible with WooCommerce version 3.7 or later.

Heleket Crypto Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
Accept Cryptocurrency Payments Seamlessly
Integrate cryptocurrency payments into your WooCommerce store with Heleket – a powerful and fully automated crypto payment gateway designed for businesses of all sizes. Whether you run an online shop, a digital service, or a subscription-based platform, Heleket allows you to accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and other top cryptocurrencies effortlessly.

With Heleket, you can receive payments from customers worldwide and instantly convert funds to stablecoins, protecting your revenue from market volatility.

Why Choose Heleket?

  • Global Access – Accept payments from anywhere, including users in Russia and other regions.
  • No KYC Hassle – Get started without lengthy verifications.
  • Auto-Conversion – Instantly convert received payments into stablecoins to avoid price fluctuations.
  • Flexible Payouts – Withdraw in USDT, BTC, ETH, or other supported assets.
  • Low Fees – Commission starts from just 0.4%, with no hidden costs.
  • Easy Integration – Connect via API or integrate directly into WooCommerce with a simple setup.
  • No Chargebacks – Enjoy secure, irreversible transactions.

How It Works

  1. A customer selects cryptocurrency as a payment method at checkout.
  2. The system generates an invoice based on real-time exchange rates.
  3. The customer completes the transaction using their preferred crypto wallet.
  4. The order is confirmed automatically, and funds are credited to your account.
  5. You can withdraw payments in stablecoins, crypto, or fiat (where supported).

Supported Cryptocurrencies

  • Bitcoin (BTC)
  • Ethereum (ETH)
  • Tether (USDT, TRC-20 & ERC-20)
  • Litecoin (LTC)
  • TRON (TRX)
  • More coins available – see full list in your merchant account.

Get Started in Minutes

  1. Install and activate the Heleket WooCommerce plugin.
  2. Sign up on Heleket and get your API keys.
  3. Configure your settings and choose your preferred payout method.
  4. Start accepting crypto payments securely and effortlessly!

Start accepting crypto payments today – install the plugin and expand your business opportunities!

Heleket website | Sign up | Contact us |
